first_impression.reaction: Okay, it answers me straight away. 'Choose the hemisphere before the venue' plus actual places in the first two lines. I didn't have to scroll through a story about someone's dream wedding. I'd read the takeaways, jump to whichever region I care about, and probably bookmark it.

journey.quote: For an August wedding abroad, choose the hemisphere before the venue.
journey.reaction: Good, a direct answer in the first sentence. That's what I came for.

journey.quote: Europe is at the height of its summer, with long evenings and warm seas, while Fiji, Mauritius and New Zealand are in their cooler months and Bali sits outside its usual wet season.
journey.reaction: Useful split, but it only names some of the ten. I want to see the whole list without scrolling.

journey.quote: 15 August is a public holiday in Italy, so ask every Italian venue and supplier how they work on and around that date.
journey.reaction: Didn't know that. This is the kind of specific thing that makes me bookmark a page.

journey.quote: August is high summer in Europe and the cooler season in Fiji, Mauritius and New Zealand, so the hemisphere shapes the wedding.
journey.reaction: The takeaways are good advice but none of them just lists the ten places. On my phone that's what I'd want in this box.

journey.section: How we chose these ten August destinations
journey.quote: A city station can differ from a villa nearby, and averaging periods and rain-day definitions vary between countries, so read each figure on its own rather than comparing destinations directly.
journey.reaction: Honest, I appreciate it. Though it's a bit of a lecture before I even get to the list.

journey.quote: The Hellenic National Meteorological Service's Naxos climatology, which does not state its averaging period, gives an August mean temperature of 25.0°C and a mean maximum of 27.0°C.
journey.reaction: Real numbers with a real source, nice. But on a phone these weather paragraphs are dense. I skimmed past the station names straight to the temperatures.

journey.quote: Summer 2026 was the hottest in France since 1900, with a heatwave running from 28 July to 19 August 2026.
journey.reaction: This answers my 'is this still true in 2026?' question. Recent and dated, which I like.

journey.quote: For more planning reading, browse the Wedded Wonderland magazine.
journey.reaction: Random plug in the middle of the list. Not a pop-up so it doesn't bother me much, but it doesn't answer my next question either.

journey.quote: | Greek islands | Hot and very dry at the Naxos station | Heat and wind on exposed terraces, busy islands |
journey.reaction: This table is the most useful bit for me and it's way down the page. I'd have loved to know it existed from the top.

journey.quote: Look south. Port Louis in Mauritius has an August mean daily maximum of 26.8°C (1971 to 2000 normals), and Fiji's met service describes August as a winter month with cool nights.
journey.reaction: Clear FAQ, answers a question I'd actually Google next.

journey.section: Southern winter and dry season escapes
journey.quote: South of the equator, August trades Europe's heat for cooler nights and, for many Australian guests, a shorter journey.
journey.reaction: Written for Australians. I'm in Singapore, so the 'closer to home' framing doesn't quite apply to me, but it doesn't stop the page being useful.

journey.section: Plan your August wedding with Wedded Concierge
journey.quote: One Wedded Advisor, start to finish, works in your time zone and quotes in AUD, and the fee is agreed in writing before any work begins.
journey.reaction: Fine, but just tell me roughly what it costs. 'Agreed in writing' doesn't tell me if this is for me.

unanswered_questions: Roughly how much does an August wedding cost in any of these places? August is peak season in Europe, so is it noticeably pricier?
What does Wedded Concierge cost, or at least how is the fee worked out?
When was this page last updated? I can't see a date anywhere.
Does Wedded Concierge work with couples outside Australia, given it quotes in AUD?

turn_offs_found.quote: The ten wedding destinations in August below are unranked, split by hemisphere and honest about the trade-offs.
turn_offs_found.why: It says ten but doesn't name them here. I have to scroll the whole page on my phone to see the list, and the at-a-glance table is near the bottom.

turn_offs_found.quote: That month's extremes ran from 32.7°C by day at Rarawai Mill in Ba to 9.8°C at night at Nadarivatu, an inland highland station.
turn_offs_found.why: Too much detail for a skim. Station names I've never heard of slow me down on a small screen.

would_share_with: My fiancé, specifically the at-a-glance table

cta_reaction.quote: Tell us your date and your guest list, and begin with Wedded Concierge.
cta_reaction.why: I only came for a list of places. I'd bookmark the page first. If I came back I might click, but without any idea of cost or whether they work with non-Australian couples I wouldn't hand over my details yet.
